sample_plate.description: 96-well plate containing up to 24 genomic DNA samples in 40 uL each (source sample plate)

temp_block.description: Temperature/cold block on slot C1 holding cold reagents in a deep-well or strip-tube format (4 columns)

rt_reservoir.description: Room-temperature deep well reservoir on slot D2 holding beads, Buffer EB, and 80% ethanol

udi_primer_plate.description: Twist UDI Primer plate with aluminum seal, pierced by robot before aspiration

working_plate.description: 96-well PCR plate used as the primary reaction plate throughout the workflow

thermocycler.description: Opentrons Flex thermocycler module (or external thermocycler preprogrammed by user)

mag_plate.description: Magnetic separation plate used during bead-based cleanup steps

elution_plate.description: 96-well plate for final eluted library product
